sentences.en: The river is navigable for small boats and canoes.
sentences.zh: 那条河适合小船和独木舟航行。

sentences.en: After the storm, it will take weeks to make the channel fully navigable again.
sentences.zh: 风暴过后，需要几周时间才能让航道重新适于通航。

sentences.en: The lake is not very deep but wide enough to be navigable by large ships.
sentences.zh: 这个湖虽然不深但足够宽阔，大型船只可以航行。

senses.zh: (江河、海洋)可航行的,可通航的;(船)适航的
